text:
liz: quick idea: add a tiny \"who changed\" pill on policy pages showing last actor / time / one-line diff + an export CTA. low-friction for on-call :eyes:
omar: yes. two engineering needs: a <200ms read path for the pill and an async export API for full history. also define export shape and quotas
neha: PII rules up front: UI shows user display name for humans; exports obey tenant redaction setting (raw | pseudonymize | redact). for pseudonymize we map to stable pseudonyms not emails :lock:
ui-ux: interaction sketch: pill sits next to policy title. click -> tiny panel with actor / timestamp / short diff. panel has \"Preview\" (cheap, fast) and \"Export\" (full bundle) buttons
liz: implementation notes: maintain a materialized latest-audit row per-policy updated on write. serve pill from redis for <50ms. full audit writes still append to stream and backfill the materialized view
infra: we can materialize on commit-hook and push to redis. need to ensure eventual consistency windows documented
omar: export API proposal: POST /v1/audit/exports {filters, redaction_mode, reason, preview?} returns job id and optionally immediate preview link if cached
neha: export bundle = NDJSON of events + separate manifest.json with actor_resolution_trace, requestor, redaction_mode, kms_key_id, truncated_flags. manifest helps compliance inspections without muddling the event stream
ui-ux: small UX detail: manifest link text = \"Download audit bundle (includes actor manifest)\". show estimate (rows / size) before confirming export
liz: quotas: preview cache (24h) is cheap quota; full exports count against tenant export credits. propose per-tenant sliding window and per-org concurrency cap. large exports get chunked automatically (>10GB)
platform-bot: queued export job: id=job-1107, est_size=35MB, ETA~2m. presigned link TTL = 7d. bundle retention = 30d by default
compliance-bot: governance note: exports spanning >90d require approval and a justification string (max 100 chars). track who requested and approvals in manifest
neha: security note: manifest must include actor_resolution_trace (algorithm and timestamps) but UI should not display raw ids unless redaction_mode==raw. telemetry should never carry resolved display names when redaction_mode != raw
omar: telemetry events we will emit: audit.pill.view, audit.export.request, audit.export.ready, audit.export.failed. telemetry payloads include actor_type, actor_role, and pseudonymized actor_hash when redacted
ui-ux: panel latency target: <200ms for pill open with cached data. show skeletons if waiting for preview. edge case: if actor is a service account show a small service icon and require an extra click to reveal email
liz: rollout plan: internal -> alpha with Dedicated customers opt-in -> GA. initial alpha toggled by feature-flag per-tenant. collect telemetry and error rates during alpha
infra: cost model: exports read from cold storage may be expensive. recommend pricing model ties export quota to tenant size and recent activity; also expose estimated cost before confirming
neha: encryption: bundles envelope-encrypted with tenant KMS; manifest stores key id and CSR fingerprint. audit trail must log which key id used
ui-ux: microcopy: when export requested show toast \"Export requested — you’ll receive a download link when ready\" and link to exports history page
liz: last coordination: I'll write RFC with API shapes, manifest schema, quota rules, and rollout steps. ping me for gaps. :thumbsup:
platform-bot: reminder: max soft export size = 50GB; system will automatically split bundles over 10GB into parts
compliance-bot: add checklist item for legal hold and retention override handling in RFC
omar: tagging infra/security for SLA and KMS handling review
ui-ux: I’ll post mocks tomorrow for the pill + panel and a compact diff view
liz: thanks all — moving to RFC draft now.
